suggestions: I'm grateful for a PR that got approved with just a "LGTM" and no thread of back-and-forth.
I'm thankful for the smell of nasi lemak wafting from the kopitiam downstairs on a morning I forgot to eat breakfast.
I'm grateful for figuring out the race condition was in my own code before blaming the framework in standup.
I'm thankful for my mother's voice note reminding me to drink more water, sent for absolutely no reason at all.
I'm grateful for the breeze right after Maghrib when the heat of the day finally lets go.
I'm thankful for a Grab driver who turned the aircon down without me having to ask.
I'm grateful for catching a bug in staging instead of production, by sheer luck more than skill.
I'm thankful for a kampung trip that reminded me WiFi isn't actually required to feel okay.
I'm grateful for the mamak uncle remembering my order is kurang manis without me saying it.
I'm thankful for a Friday prayer that ran long because the imam actually had something worth saying.
I'm grateful for finally closing that Jira ticket that's been staring at me for three sprints.
I'm thankful for an aunty's cooking showing up unannounced on a week I was too tired to cook.
I'm grateful for a standing desk and a back that doesn't complain as much as it used to.
I'm thankful for the one colleague who actually reads the PR description before commenting.
I'm grateful for waking up before the alarm, for once, with nowhere I needed to rush to.
